name: Deepsint
tagline: Enter one username and get an explainable profile card built from open-source intelligence.

awards: Cohere: Best Use of Cohere API

problem: OSINT tools are powerful but slow and spread across many tabs.
solution: Scans the open web for matching accounts, scrapes public data from each, and uses embeddings and an LLM to reason which hits belong to the same person and summarize them.
demo_moment: Team-described: type a username and get one profile card with evidence.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Cohere: Best Use of Cohere API” among 261 submissions.
One click replaces a fragmented workflow.
The same capability enables doxxing; the pitch does not address misuse.

lessons: For dual-use tools, show safeguards before judges ask.
